title: Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_b3c
description: Investigate and respond to a potential compromise involving the Sofacy group's Fysbis backdoor.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The organization has detected unusual network activity originating from the target host. Initial analysis suggests a potential compromise involving the Sofacy group's Fysbis backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. The target host has IP address `192.168.50.5`. Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario. Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the target host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services running on the system.
levels.solution: Check the status of all services and look for any that are not part of the standard system configuration. Use commands like `systemctl list-units --type=service` and `ss -tulnp` to enumerate running services.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all services and look for any that are not part of the standard system configuration.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use commands like `systemctl list-units --type=service` and `ss -tulnp` to enumerate running services.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Examine systemd services and timers to find any that are related to the suspicious service. Use commands like `systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled` and `ls /etc/systemd/system/*.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd services and timers to find any that are related to the suspicious service.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for the suspicious communication.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and listen ports to find any unusual activity. Use commands like `ss -tulnp` and `netstat -tulnp`.
